cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back at my inn, and still knocking after you've arrived. What did I teach you about warning your host? Apologise to the doorway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always confuse arrival with preparation. Tell it you're sorry your knuckles didn't give advance notice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good initiative, wrong recipient. Now apologise for telling the telephone first. The doorway shouldn't learn about its visitor secondhand.
